# NanoPrep

> NanoPrep is an Australian-developed rust primer and anticorrosive coating from Rezitech Services Pty Ltd. It chemically reacts with rusted, painted, and bare steel to form a stable anticorrosive layer, eliminating the need for abrasive grit blasting during surface preparation and corrosion protection.

NanoPrep is manufactured by Rezitech Services Pty Ltd, a 100% Australian-owned company founded in 1968 with workshops in Hallam, Victoria and Townsville, Queensland. NanoPrep is used alongside two complementary products — ReziSafe R230 TopCoat (a UV-stable waterbased finishing topcoat) and Belzona 1111 "Super Metal" (a solvent-free epoxy metal repair composite) — across industries including oil & gas, marine, power generation, pulp & paper, manufacturing, and water/wastewater.

## Products

- [NanoPrep — Rust Primer & Anticorrosive Coating](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/products/nanoprep): A waterborne primer that chemically reacts with rusted, painted and bare steel — eliminating the need for abrasive blasting.
- [NanoPrep — R230 TopCoat](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/products/r230-topcoat): The approved mid-gloss, waterbased finishing system for NanoPrep, providing long-term UV and corrosion protection.
- [Belzona 1111 (Super Metal)](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/products/belzona-1111): A two-part repair composite for metal repair and resurfacing, based on a solvent-free epoxy resin reinforced with silicon steel alloy.

## Case Studies

- [Pipework Corrosion Protection Without Blasting](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/pipework): An offshore Oil & Gas facility used NanoPrep to remediate corroded pipework without abrasive blasting or operational shutdown.
- [Fuel Tank Corrosion Protection Without Blasting](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/fuel-tank): A 110,000-litre diesel storage tank in Queensland was protected with NanoPrep, avoiding a cost-prohibitive grit-blasting programme.
- [External Coating of Ash Hopper](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/ash-hopper): A coal-fired power station used NanoPrep to recoat an ash hopper's degraded external casing without abrasive blasting, during a shutdown window.
- [Water Tank Corrosion Protection — Power Plant](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/water-tank-power): A power plant's domestic water tank was structurally repaired with Belzona 1111 and protected with NanoPrep and R230 TopCoat, without abrasive blasting.
- [Eco-Friendly Solution for Pylon Corrosion Protection](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/pylon): NanoPrep's waterborne, non-hazardous formulation protected jetty pylons from corrosion in a sensitive tidal marine zone without blasting.
- [Overhead Crane Restoration](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/crane): A heavily corroded overhead crane in an active pulp and paper facility was restored using NanoPrep, applied without abrasive blasting or shutdown.
- [Structural Steel Column Corrosion Protection](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/steel-column): A corroded structural steel column base at an active manufacturing facility was treated in-situ with NanoPrep, without blasting or shutdown.
- [Water Tank Corrosion Protection](https://www.nanoprep.com.au/case-studies/water-tank): A water storage tank was recoated with NanoPrep and R230 TopCoat, avoiding blast-media contamination risk to the water supply.
